svg.title: Typed variants inside native Burst jobs.
svg.desc: Struct-based Discriminated Unions provide the strongest polymorphism possible within Burst's strict type restrictions. Also naturally compatible with DOTS. Actual Rider declarations and Execute method · typed commands from NativeArray handled inside a native Burst job
svg.text: Typed variants inside native Burst jobs.
Struct-based Discriminated Unions provide the strongest polymorphism possible
within Burst's strict type restrictions. Also naturally compatible with DOTS.
Actual Rider declarations and Execute method · typed commands from NativeArray handled inside a native Burst job
